subject: Mechanical Engineering
title: The Fixed Pulley: Changing Direction
description: Learn The Fixed Pulley: Changing Direction in one minute.

hook.text: Pulling a rope downward to lift a bucket upward feels easier, even though the force is the same.

buildup.text: A fixed pulley changes the direction of force. You pull down and the load goes up.

discovery.text: It has a mechanical advantage of 1 — no force multiplication. But direction change matters hugely.

twist.text: Without a fixed pulley, raising a flag would mean climbing the pole. Direction is worth a lot.

climax.text: Flagpoles, well buckets, and theater curtains all rely on this simplest of pulley setups.

punchline.text: Sometimes the smartest move is just changing direction.

quiz.question: What advantage does a single fixed pulley provide?
options: It doubles the force applied to the load
It changes the direction of the applied force
It reduces the total work needed to lift the load
